name: ChatGLM2
description:
Here is how to read the ChatGLM2 config.json. The architecture class is ChatGLMModel, which is the transformers (or equivalent) module that wires embeddings, attention, the MLP, and the language-modelling head that turns hidden states into next-token logits.

hidden_size is 4,096: that is the width of every residual stream vector.

num_attention_heads is 32, so each head sees 128 dimensions (4,096 / 32). The ratio test is hidden_size / num_attention_heads = 4096 / 32 = 128. 128 is a multiple of 32 (NVIDIA warp-friendly), and a multiple of 16 (Huawei cube-friendly), and a power of two (Triton / FlashAttention-friendly). From this number alone you cannot name the training chip.

num_hidden_layers is 28: the stack is that many transformer blocks deep.

max_position_embeddings is 32,768 tokens — the context window in the config. There is no rope_scaling entry, so the rotary positions are used as-is.

tie_word_embeddings is false, so the input embedding matrix and the output LM head are separate learned matrices rather than a shared transpose.

torch_dtype is float16.

The copy of config.json is from https://huggingface.co/THUDM/chatglm2-6b/blob/main/config.json.
